Eugnosta misella has a wingspan of 9–11 mm. I re-fetched its [Wikipedia article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eugnosta_misella), which states "The wingspan is 9–11 mm," so the 20–24 mm option in the team note is not supported. That note's own rationale also contradicts it, since "roughly one centimeter" and "very small" moths do not describe 20–24 mm.
CONFIDENCE: 88
